continuous_effects.full_text_curation_added: 5 worksheet rows (SF68, jcm-meta, LMT1-48) + 2 new RCTs: L. sakei CJLS03 (body_fat/waist) and human-derived NGP Akkermansia muciniphila (Depommier 2019, weight/body_fat) - all SE-bearing
continuous_effects.human_derived_ngp_screening: 176 corpus studies recognized as NGP; 24 uncurated intervention-RCTs with variance queued (results/prediction_results/ngp_curation_queue_20260613.csv); Akkermansia Depommier curated into model
continuous_effects.genome_moderated_meta_regression_2026061: Added per-genus genomic functional features (data/strain_genome/strain_genomic_functional_features.csv: BSH/butyrate/mucin/lactate/propionate potential, taxonomy-assigned from comparative genomics) + _meta_regression_moderator. weight|kg (k=3): mucin_interaction appears to explain I2 80%->0% (slope -4.16, p=0.002) -- BUT this is a k=3 ARTIFACT: all 4 moderators give identical p=0.002/residual-I2=0% because each is collinear with the genus split (2 Akkermansia vs 1 Lactobacillus). Biologically-plausible HYPOTHESIS (Akkermansia mucin-degradation mechanism -> larger weight loss than Lactobacillus BSH/lactate) but NOT established at k=3. body_fat|kg: mucin slope -1.0 p=0.229 (not significant). Hypothesis to revisit when more Akkermansia/NGP weight RCTs are curated. Script: scripts/modeling/genome_moderated_meta_regression.py.
continuous_effects.random_effects_meta_analysis_20260613: Phase-2 methodological fix: replaced ML leave-one-study-out (inappropriate at n=5-12) with DerSimonian-Laird random-effects meta-analysis per stratum (arm_effects.random_effects_meta_analysis, CLI 'meta-analyze-effects'). HONEST INTERPRETABLE RESULT replacing '0 beat null': body_fat|kg pooled -0.44 kg [-0.74,-0.13] I2=12% (CONSISTENT reduction, CI excludes 0); BMI|kg/m2 -0.26 [-0.53,+0.02] I2=53% (suggestive, not conclusive); weight|kg -1.51 [-3.87,+0.85] I2=80% (too heterogeneous to pool). Report: effect_meta_analysis_20260613.json. Test: test_dersimonian_laird_pooled_effect_and_heterogeneity.
continuous_effects.endpoint_extraction_bugfix_20260613: 14 'endpoint' rows had curated effect_difference corrupted by mean/SD column misalignment (e.g. PMID:37111082 BMI 23.94->-0.61, weight 59.25->-1.72; PMID:40416368 weight -69.51->1.88, lipid TG 674->0.07). arm_effects._effects_from_structured now recomputes endpoint rows from the source two-arm means via _two_arm_endpoint_difference. weight|kg MAE 1.742->1.527. Test: test_endpoint_effect_difference_recomputed_from_source.
continuous_effects.microbiome_prior_covariate_result: population NGP-abundance prior as effect-model covariate gave NO robust lift (apparent weight -16% reversed once genus coverage completed -> overfitting at n=5-11/stratum); see docs/ngp_phase4_microbiome_findings.md
continuous_effects.lipid_subtype_se_experiment: wired SE derivation (p+n z-test) into the lipid de-mash branch; only 2/6 lipid_TG rows have a reliable curated n so it stays uniform_ols. Injecting 2 abstract-recovered n's to force inverse-variance produced a FRAGILE ARTIFACT (weight 'beat' null by 0.013 while BMI degraded 2x, 0.887->1.879) -> reverted as noise, not signal. SE-wiring code kept (activates only with >=3 reliable n). Honest state remains 0 strata beat null.
continuous_effects.lipid_stratum_status: FIXED: _effects_from_structured now de-mashes lipid rows into lipid_TG/TC/LDL/HDL via _split_lipid_into_subtypes, unit-normalized to mg/dL. lipid_TG models validly (5 studies, MAE 17.7 vs null 14.0 -- physically meaningful, replaces bogus pooled 'lipid|mg/dL' 41 vs 1.06). lipid_TC/LDL have 4 high-conf rows each but only 1 unique probiotic study (PMID:40066582) survives the model filter -- verified the other 3 are CORRECTLY excluded: PMID:40828642 (energy-restriction+exercise) and PMID:37545298 (low-carb diet) are non-microbial, and NCT:NCT06795607 is a duplicate of the SF68 study already counted as PMID:40965226. So lipid_TC/LDL are genuinely under-powered (data limit, NOT a join bug). Still 0 strata beat null. docs/lipid_stratum_diagnosis_20260613.md
continuous_effects.sample_size_recovery: worksheet sample_size_confirmed, then evidence_details enrollment / abstract n=
continuous_effects.confidence_policy: curated structured effects are high confidence; abstract-mined rows are low confidence and excluded from the primary model

model.level: study_arm_continuous_effect_meta_regression (endpoint-unit stratified, raw physical units, not SMD)
model.weighting: inverse-variance where >=50% of stratum rows have a computable variance, else uniform OLS
model.outlier_handling: robust MAD trim of parse-error estimates (counted per stratum)

model_readiness.reason: Architecture migrated from study-level binary classification to arm-level continuous effect-size regression; the dataset now spans the requested 60-80 studies. However the fitted endpoint-unit strata do not beat the stratum-mean baseline, so there is no predictive lift to apply to combination ranking yet. Unlocking it requires more curated studies that report extractable variance (SD/CI/p+n).

data_quality_followups: Re-curate parse-error effect estimates flagged by the outlier trim, e.g. PMID:38999741 (~202 'kg/kg-m2 change') and PMID:40416368 (~-69.5 kg endpoint mis-read as change).
